memoryBuilder.verseText: Jesus said: 'Come, follow Me, and I will make you fishers of people.'

sequence.prompt: How did Jesus find His helpers? Put it in order.

items.label: Jesus told people the good news
He walked along the edge of a lake
They left their nets and went

matches.prompt: Match each part of the story to what it means.
matches.questionTemplate: What does the story say about {left}?

pairs.right: At a lake, where people were working
Ordinary people, not clever or important
Jesus did — He came looking for them

application.question: Jesus came looking for ordinary people. What is one true thing you could tell somebody about Him?
application.followUp: Their hands smelled of fish and nobody thought they were special. Jesus walked up on an ordinary morning and chose them — and He kept them even though they got things wrong all the time. Jesus says follow Me.
